mission.name: Hello, GitOps
mission.description:
The SRE team moved the public `status-page` service to GitOps. Its manifests are in the Gitea repo
`platform/status-page` (folder `deploy/`, branch `main`), and namespace `status` has been created for it.
But nobody ever told Argo CD about the repo: `argocd app list` is empty and nothing runs in `status`.
A clone of the repo is in your workspace. The Argo CD UI is at http://localhost:9080 (admin / argomissions).
mission.objective:
An Argo CD Application named `status-page` (namespace `argocd`, project `default`) deploys folder `deploy/`
of the `status-page` repo to namespace `status` of the in-cluster destination. It is Synced and Healthy at
the current head of `main`, and Service `status-page` in `status` answers `status-page v1.0`.

mission.name: Works On My Laptop
mission.description:
The `orders` service is meant to run from the Gitea repo `platform/orders` (folder `deploy/`, branch `main`)
into namespace `orders`. The developer who created the Application cloned the repo on their laptop and
pasted that same address into Argo CD. Now `argocd app get orders` shows the Application as `Unknown` with
a ComparisonError: `failed to list refs: Get "http://localhost:3300/platform/orders.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack":
dial tcp [::1]:3300: connect: connection refused`. Yet the URL opens fine in the developer's browser.
A clone of the repo is in your workspace. The Argo CD UI is at http://localhost:9080 (admin / argomissions).
mission.objective:
Application `orders` (namespace `argocd`) reads the `orders` repo through an address Argo CD can reach from
inside the cluster. It is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, and Service `orders` in namespace
`orders` answers `orders v1.4`.

mission.name: The Moved Manifests
mission.description:
The `catalog` service is deployed by Argo CD from the Gitea repo `platform/catalog` (branch `main`) into
namespace `catalog`. Last week a teammate merged a commit called "restructure: move manifests to
deploy/catalog". Since then the Application shows `Unknown` with a ComparisonError:
`Failed to load target state: failed to generate manifest for source 1 of 1: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = k8s: app path does not exist`.
Nothing has been deployed yet. A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `catalog` (namespace `argocd`) reads the manifests where they live now, so it is Synced and
Healthy at the current head of `main`, and Service `catalog` in namespace `catalog` answers `catalog v2.0`.
The restructured layout of the repo stays as it is.

mission.name: Master Of Nothing
mission.description:
The `invoices` service is deployed by Argo CD from the Gitea repo `platform/invoices` (folder `deploy/`)
into namespace `invoices`. The team renamed the default branch from `master` to `main` months ago and moved
on. The Application, created back then, now shows `Unknown` with a ComparisonError:
`Failed to load target state: failed to generate manifest for source 1 of 1: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = unable to resolve 'master' to a commit SHA: revision not found`.
A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `invoices` (namespace `argocd`) follows the branch the team really works on. It is Synced and
Healthy at the current head of that branch, and Service `invoices` in namespace `invoices` answers
`invoices v3.1`. The repo keeps its single branch.

mission.name: No Room At The Inn
mission.description:
The `ledger` service is deployed by Argo CD from the Gitea repo `platform/ledger` (folder `deploy/`, branch
`main`) into namespace `ledger`. The first sync was attempted this morning and failed:
`one or more objects failed to apply, reason: namespaces "ledger" not found`. Nobody created that namespace
on this cluster, and the platform team wants the Application to deploy to a brand-new cluster without a
checklist of manual steps. A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `ledger` (namespace `argocd`) is configured to create its destination namespace itself. It is
Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, namespace `ledger` exists, and Service `ledger` in it
answers `ledger v1.0`.

mission.name: Cluster Not Found
mission.description:
The `telemetry` service is deployed by Argo CD from the Gitea repo `platform/telemetry` (folder `deploy/`,
branch `main`) into namespace `telemetry`, which already exists. The Application was written by hand, and
now it shows `Unknown` with this condition: `InvalidSpecError: error getting cluster by server
"https://kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local": rpc error: code = NotFound desc = cluster
"https://kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local" not found`. The repo is fine. A clone of it is in your
workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `telemetry` (namespace `argocd`) deploys to a cluster that Argo CD knows, the one it runs in, in
namespace `telemetry`. It is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, and Service `telemetry` in
that namespace answers `telemetry v1.7`.

mission.name: The Commit Nobody Shipped
mission.description:
The release manager merged "release v2.3" of `search-api` into `main` of the Gitea repo `platform/search-api`
and told the team it is live. But customers still get the old behaviour: Service `search-api` in namespace
`search` answers `search-api v2.2`, and the Argo CD Application `search-api` is `OutOfSync`. The Application
was synced once, at v2.2, and nothing has happened since. A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `search-api` (namespace `argocd`) is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, the release
reached the cluster through Argo CD, and Service `search-api` in namespace `search` answers `search-api v2.3`.

mission.name: Synced But Sick
mission.description:
The messaging team released `notifier v2.0` through Argo CD (repo `platform/notifier`, folder `deploy/`,
namespace `messaging`). The sync went through without a single error, and the Application even says
`Synced` — yet the push-notification gateway does not answer and `argocd app get notifier` reports
`Health Status: Degraded`. The release manager is sure that "green means done". A clone of the repo is in
your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `notifier` (project `default`) is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, the
Deployment `notifier` in namespace `messaging` is available, and Service `notifier` answers `notifier v2.0`.

mission.name: Sync Failed: Unknown Kind
mission.description:
The billing team is shipping `billing v3.1` through GitOps: repo `platform/billing` (folder `deploy/`, branch
`main`) and Application `billing`, which deploys to namespace `billing`. The release manager pressed Sync and it
failed at once with: `one or more synchronization tasks are not valid: failed to discover server resources for
group version policy/v1beta1: the server could not find the requested resource`. Nothing from the repo is
running in `billing`. The manifests are older than the cluster; a clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `billing` (project `default`) is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`. The repo still
ships a PodDisruptionBudget named `billing` for the workload, it exists in namespace `billing`, and Service
`billing` answers `billing v3.1`.

mission.name: The Hotfix That Must Survive
mission.description:
During last night's load spike the on-call engineer ran `kubectl scale deploy/checkout --replicas=3` in
namespace `checkout` and the `checkout` service has been holding up since. This morning Application `checkout`
(repo `platform/checkout`, folder `deploy/`) shows `OutOfSync`, and the release manager wants to "just press
Sync to clean it up". The capacity must not be lost, and nobody wants a cluster that disagrees with Git. A
clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Deployment `checkout` in namespace `checkout` keeps running 3 ready replicas, the repo's manifest on `main`
says so too, and Application `checkout` (project `default`) is Synced and Healthy at the current head of
`main`. Service `checkout` answers `checkout v5.2`.

mission.name: The Ghost Worker
mission.description:
The media team retired the `legacy-worker` Deployment: the commit "retire legacy worker" removed it from repo
`platform/media` (folder `deploy/`), and the release manager synced Application `media` right after. The sync
succeeded — yet `legacy-worker` is still running in namespace `media-prod`, eating CPU, and the Application
still says `OutOfSync`. Git no longer mentions the worker, so nobody can say what the cluster is waiting for.
mission.objective:
Deployment `legacy-worker` no longer exists in namespace `media-prod`. The rest of the application is
untouched (Deployment and Service `media-web` keep running without being recreated), and Application `media`
(project `default`) is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`. Service `media-web` answers `media v4.0`.

mission.name: Undo Without Rewriting History
mission.description:
Yesterday a colleague pushed "tune worker flags" to repo `platform/reports` (folder `deploy/`, branch `main`),
and Application `reports` was synced. Since then the report worker in namespace `reports` is not answering and
`argocd app get reports` shows `Synced` but `Degraded`; the pod restarts over and over. The nightly reports
are late, other teams already pulled `main`, and the audit log must keep showing what happened. A clone of the
repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
The previous behaviour is live again: Service `report-worker` in namespace `reports` answers `reports v1.0`.
Application `reports` (project `default`) is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`. The commit
"tune worker flags" is still part of the history of `main` (no rewritten history), and its change is undone
at the head.

mission.name: Deploy On Merge
mission.description:
The telemetry team's `metrics-gw` gateway is managed by an Argo CD Application of the same name. The team
agreed that every merge to `main` of the Gitea repo `platform/metrics-gw` must reach the cluster without
anyone touching Argo CD. Yet three releases (v1.1, v1.2 and v1.3) were merged today and the Application
just sits there: `argocd app get metrics-gw` says `OutOfSync` and the gateway in namespace `metrics` still
answers `metrics-gw v1.0`. A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `metrics-gw` deploys new commits of `main` on its own, with no manual sync. It is Synced and
Healthy at the current head of `main`, and Service `metrics-gw` in namespace `metrics` answers
`metrics-gw v1.3`.

mission.name: The Drift That Stays
mission.description:
During last night's incident an engineer edited the live `pricing-api` objects in namespace `pricing` by hand:
the Deployment was scaled up and the discount cap in ConfigMap `pricing-rules` was raised. The Application
`pricing-api` has automated sync enabled, yet this morning `argocd app get pricing-api` still shows `OutOfSync`
and `argocd app diff pricing-api` lists the manual edits, which nobody reverted. Finance is not amused: the
repo `platform/pricing-api` (a clone is in your workspace) says what production must look like.
mission.objective:
Application `pricing-api` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, the live Deployment and ConfigMap
`pricing-rules` match what Git says (the manifests in Git stay as they are), and the Application undoes such
manual edits by itself from now on. Service `pricing-api` in namespace `pricing` answers `pricing-api v2.0`.

mission.name: Automated, But Not Tidy
mission.description:
The photo team retired the old `gallery-classic` Service: its manifest was deleted from `deploy/` in the Gitea
repo `platform/gallery-web` (a clone is in your workspace). Application `gallery-web` has automated sync, yet
the Service is still answering in namespace `gallery` and the Application is stuck on `OutOfSync`;
`argocd app get gallery-web` lists `gallery-classic` as `OutOfSync` and the sync never runs by itself. Security
wants the retired endpoint gone, and wants it to stay that way for every manifest the team retires from now on.
mission.objective:
Application `gallery-web` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, Service `gallery-classic` no
longer exists in namespace `gallery` (and Git still does not contain it), and the Application removes objects
that disappear from Git on its own. Service `gallery-web` in `gallery` answers `gallery-web v3.1`.

mission.name: Keep The Data
mission.description:
Application `media-store` (auto-sync with prune, namespace `media`) serves customer photos and keeps them on
PersistentVolumeClaim `uploads`, which is declared in `deploy/pvc.yaml` of the Gitea repo `platform/media-store`
(a clone is in your workspace). The platform team is moving all storage to a separate `storage` application
that will adopt the existing claim next week, so `pvc.yaml` has to leave this repository today. The storage
audit recorded the claim's UID in ConfigMap `storage-audit`; a claim that is deleted and re-created cannot get
its volume, and the photos, back. There is no undo: if the claim is deleted, restart the mission.
mission.objective:
The `uploads` PersistentVolumeClaim manifest is gone from the `media-store` repo (the Deployment and Service
stay) and the Application still has auto-prune enabled, yet in namespace `media` the live claim `uploads` is
still the original one (same UID as in `storage-audit`, Bound, not being deleted). Application `media-store`
is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main` and Service `media-store` answers `media-store v1.4`.

mission.name: Fighting The Autoscaler
mission.description:
Application `quote-api` (namespace `quotes`, repo `platform/quote-api`, a clone is in your workspace) has
automated sync with self-heal, and the manifest in Git pins `replicas: 2`. Under load the platform's
autoscaler, the controller `load-scaler` in namespace `quotes-scaler` (it does what an HPA does; the cluster has
no metrics-server, so it is a small stand-in), keeps raising the Deployment to 4 replicas. Since then
`kubectl -n quotes get deploy quote-api -w` shows the replica count jumping between 2 and 4, pods starting and
dying, and `argocd app get quote-api` is `OutOfSync` with an `Automated` operation that keeps running again
and again. The autoscaler belongs to another team and must keep working.
mission.objective:
Application `quote-api` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, with self-heal still enabled.
Deployment `quote-api` in `quotes` holds the 4 replicas the autoscaler wants, with nobody rewriting its spec
back and forth. The `load-scaler` controller still runs, and Service `quote-api` answers `quote-api v5.0`.

mission.name: The Webhook's Signature
mission.description:
Application `profile-svc` (namespace `profiles`, repo `platform/profile-svc`, a clone is in your workspace) has
automated sync, nobody has touched it, and still `argocd app get profile-svc` is `OutOfSync` all day long: a
sync clears it and a few seconds later it is back. `argocd app diff profile-svc` shows one thing, the
`cost-center` label of the Deployment, which Git sets to `unassigned` while the live object carries something
like `cc-1763300000` that keeps changing. The finance platform's controller `cost-stamper` (namespace
`profiles-finops`, a stand-in for the mutating webhook or allocation operator that does this in real clusters)
stamps every Deployment it knows, and finance needs it to keep doing so.
mission.objective:
Application `profile-svc` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main` and stays Synced while
`cost-stamper` keeps rewriting the label on the live Deployment. The controller still runs, and Service
`profile-svc` in namespace `profiles` answers `profile-svc v2.3`.

mission.name: Field Is Immutable
mission.description:
The help-desk team shipped release v1.1 of `ticket-desk` (repo `platform/ticket-desk`, folder `deploy/`, namespace
`helpdesk`). One commit also moved every label to the `app.kubernetes.io/name` convention, including the
Deployment's pod selector. Syncing the `ticket-desk` Application now fails: Argo CD reports
`Deployment.apps "ticket-desk" is invalid: spec.selector: Invalid value: {"matchLabels":{"app.kubernetes.io/name":"ticket-desk"}}: field is immutable`.
The Application stays OutOfSync, and the Service no longer finds its pods. A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `ticket-desk` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`. Git keeps the new
`app.kubernetes.io/name` selector, the live Deployment `ticket-desk` in `helpdesk` uses it, two pods are ready,
and Service `ticket-desk` answers `ticket-desk v1.1`.

mission.name: Annotation Too Long
mission.description:
The network team publishes the full CMDB export (about 9,000 hosts, roughly 400 KB) as ConfigMap `host-inventory`
in the repo `platform/host-registry` (folder `deploy/`), served by the `host-registry` Deployment in namespace `netops`.
The `host-registry` Application has never synced: Argo CD stops at the ConfigMap with
`ConfigMap "host-inventory" is invalid: metadata.annotations: Too long: may not be more than 262144 bytes`.
The pod waits for a ConfigMap that does not exist. A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `host-registry` (namespace `argocd`) is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, and its
last sync succeeded. ConfigMap `host-inventory` in `netops` holds the complete export (all 9,000 hosts, still
in Git), the application declares how it is applied so the next sync succeeds too, and Service `host-registry`
answers `host-registry v1.0`.

mission.name: Nothing Left To Deploy
mission.description:
The platform team took over the ETL workloads, so a commit in `platform/nightly-etl` emptied folder `deploy/`
(only a README is left). The `nightly-etl` Application has automated sync with prune and self-heal, yet nothing
happens: it is OutOfSync and shows `SyncError: Skipping sync attempt to <commit>: auto-sync will wipe out all
resources`. Deployment `etl-worker`, Service `etl-status` and ConfigMap `etl-schedule` keep running in namespace `etl`.
A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `nightly-etl` is Synced at the current head of `main` and its last sync succeeded. The manifests stay out
of the repo, and namespace `etl` no longer contains Deployment `etl-worker`, Service `etl-status` or ConfigMap
`etl-schedule`.

mission.name: Flaky First Contact
mission.description:
`sensor-hub` (repo `platform/sensor-hub`, namespace `iot-edge`) ships a `SensorProfile` custom resource next to its
Deployment. The CRD behind it is installed by the platform bootstrap (`kubectl -n iot-bootstrap get jobs`), which
finishes a few minutes after a cluster comes up, but the Application syncs first. Its automated sync fails with
`SyncError: Failed last sync attempt to <commit>: one or more synchronization tasks are not valid: failed to discover
server resources for group version runtime.argomissions.io/v1: the server could not find the requested resource
(retried 2 times).` and then stops. Nothing runs in `iot-edge`.
mission.objective:
Application `sensor-hub` keeps its automated sync and is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, its last
sync succeeded, and the SensorProfile `edge-default` exists. Its sync policy now retries patiently enough
(at least five minutes of attempts in total) that a CRD arriving late no longer leaves the Application failed. Service
`sensor-hub` in `iot-edge` answers `sensor-hub v2.0`.

mission.name: Two Owners, One ConfigMap
mission.description:
Two Applications, `cart-service` and `promo-banner`, deploy folders `cart/` and `promo/` of the repo
`platform/storefront-apps` into namespace `storefront`. Both folders contain a ConfigMap named `feature-flags`,
each with its own flag. `promo-banner` is OutOfSync and stays that way, with
`SharedResourceWarning: ConfigMap/feature-flags is part of applications argocd/promo-banner and cart-service`.
The live ConfigMap only holds the flag of whichever Application got there first. A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Both Applications `cart-service` and `promo-banner` are Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, neither
reports a SharedResourceWarning, and exactly one of them defines ConfigMap `feature-flags` in Git and tracks it.
The live ConfigMap holds both flags (`checkout_v2: "true"` and `promo_banner: "on"`), and both Services answer
(`cart-service v4.1`, `promo-banner v2.3`).

mission.name: The Slow Sync
mission.description:
The `region-configs` Application (repo `platform/region-configs`, folder `deploy/`, namespace `regions`) holds eight
per-region ConfigMaps, the `edge-banner` Deployment and `visit-counter`, a ConfigMap the analytics controller keeps
updating at runtime (the Application ignores differences on `/data/count`, so it never shows as drifted). Every sync so far
re-applied all 11 objects: the last release quietly reset `visit-counter` to its Git value `0`, and analytics lost its
history. The counter reads 4821 again and release r42 is waiting (the Application is OutOfSync, sync policy manual).
A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Release r42 is deployed: `region-configs` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, its last sync succeeded, Service
`edge-banner` answers `edge-banner r42` and ConfigMap `region-eu-west` has `banner-template: spring`. ConfigMap `visit-counter`
still holds `4821`, and the Application is configured so that its syncs only apply the objects that are out of sync.

mission.name: Values Not Found
mission.description:
The `weather-api` forecast service is a Helm chart in the Gitea repo `platform/weather-api` (folder `chart/`,
branch `main`). Its Argo CD Application was created last week, yet nothing runs in namespace `weather`:
the Application shows `Unknown` sync status and a `ComparisonError` condition that ends with
`Error: open <path to cached source>/chart/values-prod.yaml: no such file or directory`.
A clone of the repo is in your workspace. The Argo CD UI is at http://localhost:9094 (admin / argomissions).
mission.objective:
Application `weather-api` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, with the production
configuration of the chart applied: Deployment `weather-api` in namespace `weather` has 2 ready pods and
Service `weather-api` answers `weather-api prod 3.2` (not the laptop defaults).

mission.name: The Parameter That Wins
mission.description:
During an incident two weeks ago somebody pinned the `media-gateway` banner to a hotfix build. Since then the
release team bumped `release.version` in `chart/values.yaml` of the Gitea repo `platform/media-gateway` to
`2.1`, and Argo CD reports the Application `media-gateway` as Synced and Healthy at the new commit.
Yet the gateway in namespace `media` still answers `media-gateway 1.9.1-hotfix`, and every further version
bump in Git changes nothing. A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `media-gateway` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, carries no override for the
release version, and Service `media-gateway` in namespace `media` answers `media-gateway ` followed by the
version that `chart/values.yaml` in Git declares.

mission.name: The Renamed Release
mission.description:
The `fleet-tracker` team moved from plain manifests to a Helm chart: the Application `fleet-tracker` now
reads `chart/` of the Gitea repo `platform/fleet-tracker` instead of `manifests/`. Argo CD says Synced and
Healthy, but every consumer of `http://tracker-api.fleet` now fails with "could not resolve host".
`kubectl -n fleet get svc,deploy` shows objects called `fleet-tracker-api`, and the old `tracker-api`
Deployment and Service are gone. Other teams cannot change the name they call. A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `fleet-tracker` keeps deploying the Helm chart (path `chart`) and is Synced and Healthy at the
current head of `main`. Deployment and Service are named `tracker-api` in namespace `fleet` (managed by the
Application, nothing named `fleet-tracker-api` left over), and the Service answers `tracker-api v3 (helm chart)`.

mission.name: Inline Values, Ignored
mission.description:
The search team keeps production settings inside the Argo CD Application `search-suggest` (the `valuesObject`
field) and leaves `chart/values.yaml` of the Gitea repo `platform/search-suggest` as development defaults.
The Application is Synced and Healthy, there is no error anywhere, and still namespace `search` runs a single
pod and the service answers `search-suggest dev defaults`: the production values are silently not used.
A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `search-suggest` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main` and keeps the production
settings inline in the Application (the chart defaults in Git stay as they are). Deployment `search-suggest`
in namespace `search` runs 3 ready replicas and Service `search-suggest` answers `search-suggest prod 4.1`.

mission.name: The Base Is Not An Environment
mission.description:
The `inventory-sync` service has a Kustomize layout in the Gitea repo `platform/inventory-sync`:
`kustomize/base` plus an overlay per environment. The Application `inventory-sync` was created for
production, and it is Synced and Healthy. But namespace `inventory` runs one pod and the service answers
`inventory-sync base`, while the production overlay is supposed to run three replicas with its own settings.
A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `inventory-sync` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main` and deploys the production
environment to namespace `inventory`: Deployment `inventory-sync` has 3 ready replicas and Service
`inventory-sync` answers `inventory-sync prod`. The shared base stays a neutral base.

mission.name: Promote Without Editing YAML
mission.description:
`ticket-desk` is a Kustomize app in the Gitea repo `platform/ticket-desk`: the base refers to the logical image
`ticket-desk-web`, and each overlay maps it to a real image. Build 2.0 (`traefik/whoami:v1.10`) was
validated in staging, but the production overlay still maps the alias to the old build `nginx:1.27-alpine`, so
Application `ticket-desk` keeps serving the old nginx page from namespace `desk`. Production has to run
build 2.0 now. The change window is tonight and the release engineer wants it done through the Application
itself, with no new commit in the app repo. A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `ticket-desk` keeps deploying `kustomize/overlays/prod`, is Synced and Healthy at the current head
of `main`, and Deployment `ticket-desk` in namespace `desk` runs the image `traefik/whoami:v1.10` on at least
2 ready pods; Service `ticket-desk` answers like build 2.0 (a whoami response).

mission.name: Selector Is Immutable
mission.description:
The platform team asked every service to carry the labels `team: ledger` and `cost-center: cc-4711`. A
colleague added them to the Kustomize package in `platform/ledger-api` (folder `deploy/`, branch `main`)
and synced Application `ledger-api` from the UI. The sync failed: the operation message ends in
`Deployment.apps "ledger-api" is invalid: spec.selector: Invalid value: {...}: field is immutable`.
The old pods are still serving, the Application is OutOfSync, and a clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `ledger-api` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`. The pods of Deployment
`ledger-api` in namespace `ledger` carry the labels `team=ledger` and `cost-center=cc-4711`, the Deployment's
selector is still only `app: ledger-api` (the Deployment is not deleted and re-created with a wider selector),
and Service `ledger-api` answers `ledger-api v2.2`.

mission.name: Half The Manifests
mission.description:
The warehouse team keeps the `inventory` service in the Gitea repo `platform/inventory-stack`: a web tier in
`deploy/web/` and a database stub in `deploy/db/`. Argo CD Application `inventory` (path `deploy`, branch
`main`, namespace `inventory`) looks perfect in the UI: Synced, Healthy, a green tick. Yet `kubectl get all -n
inventory` is empty and the web service does not exist. A clone of the repo is in your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `inventory` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main` and manages both tiers:
Deployments `stock-web` and `stock-db` and their Services run in namespace `inventory`, and Service
`stock-web` answers `stock-web v3.1`. The folder layout of the repo stays as it is (`deploy/web`,
`deploy/db`).

mission.name: Test Fixtures In Production
mission.description:
Application `collector` deploys folder `deploy/` of the Gitea repo `platform/telemetry-agents` (branch `main`)
to namespace `telemetry`, with automated sync and pruning. It is Synced and Healthy, but the namespace is
crowded: `kubectl get pods -n telemetry` shows `fixture-loadgen` and `fixture-fake-source` next to the real

mission.name: Detected As The Wrong Tool

mission.name: Migrate Before You Deploy
mission.description:
Release v2 of `payroll-api` is merged on `main` of the Gitea repo `platform/payroll-api`. Besides the new

Application `payroll-api` (namespace `argocd`) is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, release v2

mission.name: Config Before Code
mission.description:

mission.objective:
Application `shipping-ui` (namespace `argocd`) is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, its last
sync operation Succeeded at that commit, and Service `shipping-ui` in namespace `shipping` answers
`shipping-ui carrier=dhl`.

mission.name: Unknown Kind On First Sync
mission.description:
The plant monitoring stack lives in the Gitea repo `platform/sensor-hub`: `crds/` holds the `Probe`
CustomResourceDefinition (API group `sensors.argomissions.io`), `hub/` holds the first `Probe` instance. Two

mission.objective:
Both Applications (`sensor-crds`, `sensor-hub`, namespace `argocd`) are Synced and Healthy at the current head

`sensor-crds` (not applied by hand), and the `Probe` named `boiler-temp` exists in namespace `sensors` and is
owned by `sensor-hub`.

mission.name: Job Already Exists
mission.description:
Release v2 of `helpdesk-api` (Gitea repo `platform/helpdesk-api`, folder `deploy/`) changes the PreSync
migration Job `helpdesk-db-migrate`. The sync of v2 stopped at the hook: the operation is `Failed` with

your workspace.
mission.objective:
Application `helpdesk-api` (namespace `argocd`) is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, the sync
that deployed it Succeeded and ran the migration Job, and Service `helpdesk-api` in namespace `helpdesk`
answers `helpdesk-api v2`. The migration Job is defined in Git so that the next change to it will not collide
with the run that is left behind from this one.

mission.name: The Test That Fails The Sync
mission.description:
`booking-web` (Gitea repo `platform/booking-web`, folder `deploy/`, namespace `booking`) has a PostSync smoke
test, Job `booking-web-smoke-test`, that calls the Service after every sync. The sync of the Application

mission.objective:
Application `booking-web` (namespace `argocd`) is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, and its
last sync operation Succeeded at that commit, including a PostSync smoke test that ran and passed against
the Service. Service `booking-web` in namespace `booking` still answers `booking-web v1.4` on port 80.

mission.name: The Hook That Never Ran
mission.description:
Release v3.1 of `ticket-desk` (Gitea repo `platform/ticket-desk`, folder `deploy/`, namespace `helpdesk`)

mission.objective:
Application `ticket-desk` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, and the last sync of that
head ran Job `reindex-tickets` as a hook that finishes before the rollout (the Job completed and logged
`index rebuilt`). Service `ticket-desk` in namespace `helpdesk` still answers `ticket-desk v3.1`.

mission.name: Stuck In Wave 1
mission.description:
Release v1.4 of `fleet-tracker` (Gitea repo `platform/fleet-tracker`, folder `deploy/`, namespace `fleet`)
was synced an hour ago and the sync is still running: `argocd app get fleet-tracker --show-operation` says

mission.objective:
Application `fleet-tracker` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, and that head was deployed
by a completed (Succeeded) sync. Deployments `tracker-api` and `tracker-web` in namespace `fleet` are ready
and Service `tracker-web` answers `fleet-tracker v1.4`. The fix lives in Git.

mission.name: Clean Up On Failure
mission.description:
Every sync of `booking-portal` (Gitea repo `platform/booking-portal`, folder `deploy/`, namespace `bookings`)
raises a "read-only" maintenance banner first (ConfigMap `maintenance-flag`) and lowers it again with the

mission.objective:
The next sync of the current head of `main` of `booking-portal` still fails at the schema gate (that release is
not yours to fix), but this time the failure itself lowers the banner: the last sync operation of the head is
Failed, a failure hook Job ran in it and Succeeded, and ConfigMap `maintenance-flag` no longer exists in

mission.name: Remove The Old Last
mission.description:
Release v2.0 of `chat-relay` (Gitea repo `platform/chat-relay`, folder `deploy/`, namespace `chat`) renames the

mission.objective:
Application `chat-relay` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, deployed by a Succeeded sync of that
head. The rename is complete: Service and Deployment `relay` are gone, `relay-gateway` answers
`chat-relay v2.0`, and Job `handover-check` of that sync recorded that the old Service `relay` and the new

mission.name: Migration Job Forbidden
mission.description:

Application `payroll-engine` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main`, deployed by a Succeeded sync of

mission.name: Repo Not Permitted

mission.name: Secrets Are Blocked

mission.name: CI Cannot Sync
mission.description:

The account must stay as it is (`apiKey, login`).

mission.name: A Token For The Pipeline
mission.description:
The release pipeline of the settlements team runs in namespace `settle-ci` and has to deploy `settle-api`

The Secret `argocd-pipeline-token` (key `token`) in namespace `settle-ci` holds a valid Argo CD token that

Synced and Healthy.

mission.name: Everyone Is Admin
mission.description:
A new hire on the claims team, `bob`, wanted to tidy the Argo CD UI and clicked **Delete** on an Application
that was not his. It worked. Digging into why, the platform team found that `policy.default: role:admin` in

`bob` can look at everything (`get` on applications, projects and clusters) but cannot sync, update, create,
override or delete anything. `alice` can still do everything, including deleting Applications and creating
projects. The `admin` account and Application `claims-portal` are untouched and `claims-portal` is still
Synced and Healthy.

mission.name: Update Is Not Delete
mission.description:
The loyalty on-call engineer `mira` (password `mira-pw-4821`) used to restart the `rewards-engine` Deployment
and kick stuck Pods from the Argo CD UI. Since the platform moved to Argo CD 3.x, both fail with

mission.objective:
As `mira`, Argo CD accepts the `restart` resource action on Deployments and the deletion of Pods in

found", not "permission denied"). It still refuses to delete other resources (Secrets, Deployments), to run

mission.name: Frozen Friday
mission.description:
Before the month-end billing run the platform team froze `billing-core` with a deny sync window (every minute,
24 hours long, all applications). The freeze is meant to stop routine, automated deployments. Then a rounding
bug in `statement-api` was found and fixed in `main` of the Gitea repo `platform/statement-api`, and the

mission.objective:
The fixed commit at the head of `main` is deployed by an Argo CD sync of Application `statement-api` (project
`billing-core`, namespace `statements`): it is Synced and Healthy at the head and the service answers
`statement-api v1.4.1`. AppProject `billing-core` still has a deny sync window, and a manual sync of its

mission.name: Who Owns This?
mission.description:
Namespace `search` is managed by the Application `query-service` (project `search-platform`) and Argo CD

Project `search-platform` has orphaned-resource monitoring enabled, and Application `query-service` reports no

mission.name: The Empty Root

Application `shopfront-root` stays Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main` and, through Argo CD itself,

mission.name: Children In The Wrong Namespace

mission.objective:
Application `billing-root` is Synced and Healthy at the current head of `main` and maintains the child Applications
`invoice-api` and `dunning-worker` in namespace `argocd`; no Application object is left in any other namespace.
Both children are Synced and Healthy at head, Service `invoice-api` in `billing-invoice` answers `invoice-api v3.2`

mission.name: Orphaned Children
mission.description:

AppProject `tracing-team` exists and is maintained by `tracing-root` from the repo (not created by hand). It allows

mission.name: Deleting The Child Left Everything
mission.description:

mission.name: The Day The Root Was Deleted
mission.description:
Root Application `inventory-root` (repo `platform/inventory-gitops`, folder `apps/`, automated sync with prune)
creates one child Application per inventory service, and every child carries `resources-finalizer.argocd.argoproj.io`
